_help: Edit this file then SAVE — the running mock server reloads it live (no restart). Coords are meters in the SCENE frame: x = forward (corridor direction), y = left, z = up. yaw_deg rotates a box about +z. color is RRGGBBAA hex; the LAST TWO hex digits = ALPHA (00=invisible, FF=opaque) — lower them to make things more transparent. A box's height = 2 * half[2]; keep pos z = half[2] so the wall stands on the floor.
